summary.headline: Servants and Captives in Nativities
summary.text: Astrological judgments on servants and captives: fortunate or afflicted Mercury, the sixth and twelfth houses, their lords, the Part of Servants, and the Moon’s Dragon’s Tail signify abundance and joy or paucity, impediment, and sadness. The text also directs examination of the most dignified stars, the ascendant lord, and the star or stars in the sixth house.
